
# Preface {.unnumbered}

Welcome to *Statistics for Movement Science* (First Edition), a hands-on guide designed to help you learn statistical methods through the lens of human movement research. This book integrates statistical concepts with practical SPSS applications, using examples from kinesiology, exercise science, and biomechanics. This edition is based on SPSS version 31.

## How to Use This Book

- Follow chapters in order for a guided learning path.
- Run the examples in SPSS 31 as you read to reinforce each concept.
- Keep notes on any workflow differences you notice in your environment.

## Support This Book {#support}
